data.name: Ellen
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root ‘el’, meaning ‘god’, and the Hebrew word ‘helén’, meaning ‘shining light’ or ‘bright sun’. The name Ellen was traditionally given to girls born during the daytime, and it was believed to bring blessings and protection to their families. In the Bible, Ellen refers to the wife of Seth and the mother of Enos.

data.numerology_meaning: Ellen is a name with the Life Path Number 5, which represents change, creativity, and adventure.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Ellen holds significant spiritual meaning, as it is rooted in the Hebrew word ‘el’, which means ‘god’. This connection makes it an inherently sacred name, reminding us of the presence and power of the Divine in our lives. Ultimately, Ellen’s spiritual significance highlights the importance of faith and the belief in a higher power that illuminates our path and grants us protection and blessings.

historical_references.reference: Ellen the Fair, also known as Helena of Constantinople, was the mother of Emperor Constantine the Great. Born around 250 AD, she was a Christian princess from the Roman province of Dacia (present-day Romania). She was said to have discovered the True Cross on which Jesus was crucified in Jerusalem around 326 AD during a pilgrimage.

In Christian culture, Ellen is associated with the wife of Seth and the mother of Enos in the Bible, making it a name with deep spiritual significance.
